title: the same scan over *.md and *.json is confined to docs/ and tests/fixtures/
titleZh: 同样的扫描覆盖 *.md 与 *.json,命中只允许出现在 docs/ 与 tests/fixtures/
why: The acceptance for this suite requires the scan to cover *.md and *.json as well, because a value can hide in a JSON config just as easily as in a script. Measured records (docs/) and captured fixtures (tests/fixtures/) are the two documented exceptions; anything else - a manifest, a case file, a label file - must be clean.
inject: every *.md and *.json in the plugin, with the two documented roots excluded
